killedBy: the screen-state catalogue waits for the Configuration body it measures, after the pane, since it loads on the first open (issue #1015)
why: Issue #1015. The Configuration screen state stops waiting for its built body. The body now loads when the pane opens, and the pane is visible before it, so a capture that waits only for `.hud-devcfg` can measure `.hud-devcfg-presets`, `.hud-devcfg-group` and the rest before they exist -- an absent measured selector fails only in a real capture.
